item.title: octoprint: 1.11.8 -> 2.0.1
item.description:
Release notes: https://github.com/OctoPrint/OctoPrint/releases#release-2.0.1 Diff: https://github.com/OctoPrint/OctoPrint/compare/1.11.8...2.0.1

Fixes the following CVEs: GitHub Security Advisory or CVE-2026-123363.

GitHub Security Advisory or CVE-2026-123360.

GitHub Security Advisory or CVE-2026-123361.

GitHub Security Advisory or CVE-2026-123362.

GitHub Security Advisory or CVE-2026-123365.

GitHub Security Advisory or CVE-2026-123366.

Breaking changes

  • This release of OctoPrint requires Python 3.9+. Python 3.7 & 3.8, still supported by OctoPrint 1.11.x, are no longer supported. Please also see this FAQ entry on OctoPrint's Python version requirements.
  • A ton of long deprecated methods and endpoints have finally been removed in this release. This should mostly affect third party plugins & the odd client. A migration guide is provided containing a full list of the removals and behaviour changes done, and the necessary steps for plugins to stay compatible.
  • Calling octoprint without a subcommand -- as deprecated for close to a decade now -- is no longer supported. Use octoprint serve to run the server. See octoprint --help for built-in documentation. The subscribe command on the push API/websocket no longer supports regular expressions as its logs or messages parameters, but only a basic search term (foo), prefix (foo*) or suffix (*foo) as well as True or False as before.

Configure the proxy to pass the correct Host header (e.g. Apache ProxyPreserveHost On, nginx proxy_set_header Host $host) or SERVER_NAME, or, if every request comes through a proxy that sets the header, set $CGI::TRUST_X_FORWARDED_HOST = 1.
  • Request size limits now apply by default: $CGI::POST_MAX (128MB), $CGI::MAX_PARAMS (10,000) and $CGI::MAX_UPLOADS (1,000). Requests exceeding them get a 413 Request entity too large cgi_error. Set any of them to -1 to remove the limit.
  • Upload filenames no longer include any client side path. The raw value is still in uploadInfo($fh)->{'Content-Disposition'}, or set $CGI::SANITIZE_UPLOAD_FILENAMES = 0. redirect() no longer HTML decodes its URL: pass /x?a=1&b=2, not /x?a=1&b=2.
  • Taint mode users must untaint the additional values listed in issue 13.
  • CGI::Cookie dies if path, domain or expires contain ; or control characters.
  • The minimum perl version is now 5.10.
